accent.role: The one accent. Blue: trust, and already the round-9 identity. Green would read as 'go/healthy' and clash with the success semantic; teal would fight the emerald success tone.
accent.usage: Primary buttons, active nav, links, the bar-chart fill, the 'now' rule. Under 10% of any screen.

semantic.note: State only, never decoration. Badges are dark text on a light chip (the -800 shade on a -100 fill in light mode, -300 on a -900/40 fill in dark mode), so the words pass AA even though the pure fill would not as text. StatCard icon chips use the -600 shade in light mode and -400 in dark mode (icons are graphics, 3:1). Chart fills are graphics, never small text.

elevation.note: Two levels only. The old shadow-glow (a blue-tinted glow under the Live-call CTA) is gone in 0.3.7 — one shadow scale, no glow.

motion: State changes only (new chat bubble, toast, call timer, typing dots). No staggered entrances, no shimmer, no breathing dots, no hover lift. Enforced by tests/test_copy_guard.py.
signature: The day book — one ruled row pattern: a fixed mono time gutter with 1px hairline separators, shared by Today's appointments and Recent calls. The next appointment today carries the single 2px primary rule and a Next label. Nothing else on a row is coloured.

type.display: Satoshi 700, tight tracking — headings, stat values, greeting
type.figures: Satoshi ships a real tnum feature (verified with fontTools in round 9); tabular-nums is on for every figure.
type.mono: System mono stack (ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas) — slot times, call timestamps, phone numbers only. No new font download.
type.text: Satoshi 400/500, 16px body at 1.6 line height, max 68ch
